_doc: Human-owned policy for diet codes: the only diet file that needs careful review. Every code found in the data (diet_vocab.json) gets a rule automatically; this file adds thresholds, contradictions and composite concepts. A code with reviewed=false is still searched and verified, but an order that relies on it always needs a person (guardrail 'diet rule reviewed by a person'). Only the two lactose rules are reviewed; the rest are proposals drafted by Claude on 2026-11-14 from diet_coverage.md. Review a rule with `python3 review_diet_rule.py CODE` (sheet in review/) and sign it with `--sign CODE --by NAME`, which sets the review fields below without touching the rest of this file. The lactose rules still carry the placeholder reviewer 'demo team' and no signed sheet. Fields: reviewed, reviewed_by, reviewed_at (required once reviewed; shown in every audit trail that relies on the rule), review_sheet_sha256 (hash of the sheet the reviewer signed; the offline tests fail when the sheet changes later), label, description, nutrient_max / nutrient_min (g per 100 g, nutrient id from diet_vocab.json), nutrient_contradicts (default true), free_from (GS1 nonAllergen FREE_FROM codes that count as positive evidence, all required), contradict_allergens (GS1 allergen codes), contradict_may_contain (default false), also_satisfied_by (codes that also satisfy this one), inherent_categories (catalogue categories whose products are whole unprocessed produce and naturally meet the rule; an allergen entry still contradicts), note.

FREE_FROM_LACTOSE.label: lactose-free
FREE_FROM_LACTOSE.note: ≤ 0.01 g lactose / 100 g. ML = lactose. AM (milk) is NOT a contradiction: lactose-free milk is still milk.

LOW_LACTOSE.label: low-lactose
LOW_LACTOSE.note: ≤ 1 g lactose / 100 g. Lactose-free products also qualify (derived from the claim grammar).

FREE_FROM_GLUTEN.label: gluten-free
FREE_FROM_GLUTEN.note: inherent_categories = whole unprocessed fresh vegetables, fruit, potatoes, root vegetables, mushrooms and berries (no milk or gluten allergen in any of them, checked 2026-11-14; peeled whole potatoes and roots (17422, 17432) are included; cooked, cut, mixed and dried produce is excluded). AW = cereals containing gluten, NR = rye, GB = barley (all suppressed under the claim, see diet_coverage.md). UW (wheat) is deliberately NOT a contradiction: gluten-free wheat starch exists. MAY_CONTAIN counts (coeliac).

FREE_FROM_WHEAT.label: wheat-free
FREE_FROM_WHEAT.note: Only 141 claims: the co-occurrence statistics are too small to suggest contradictions, so this is from the GS1 code list.

VEGAN.label: vegan
VEGAN.note: Animal-derived allergens contradict the claim. MAY_CONTAIN is cross-contact and normal for vegan products (356 in the catalogue), so it does not count.

VEGETARIAN.label: vegetarian
VEGETARIAN.note: Fish and shellfish contradict the claim; meat cannot be detected from allergen data.

LOW_FAT.label: low-fat
LOW_FAT.note: EU 1924/2006: 3 g / 100 g for solids, 1.5 g / 100 ml for liquids; liquids are not distinguished here.

FREE_FROM_SODIUM_SALT.label: salt-free
FREE_FROM_SODIUM_SALT.note: ≤ 0.005 g sodium = 0.0125 g salt / 100 g (SALTEQ is salt, not sodium).

HIGH_FIBRE.label: high-fibre
HIGH_FIBRE.note: EU also accepts ≥ 3 g / 100 kcal, which is not modelled, so a low value supports nothing but is not treated as a contradiction.

HIGH_PROTEIN.label: high-protein
HIGH_PROTEIN.note: EU: ≥ 20 % of energy from protein; not modelled, claim only.

NO_ADDED_SUGARS.label: no added sugar
NO_ADDED_SUGARS.note: The data cannot separate added from natural sugar: claim only.

DAIRY_FREE.label: dairy-free
DAIRY_FREE.description: dairy-free / milk-free (no milk protein and no lactose, e.g. for a milk allergy). Different from lactose-free.
DAIRY_FREE.note: No GS1 claim exists for this; evidence is the nonAllergen FREE_FROM AM entry (3,586 products), or the GS1 VEGAN claim (a vegan product has no milk ingredient), or whole unprocessed produce (inherent_categories). CONTAINS or MAY_CONTAIN AM / ML always contradicts, whatever the evidence. Proposed 2026-11-14 for the hospital scenario; needs a person's review.

NUT_FREE.label: nut-free
NUT_FREE.description: free from tree nuts and peanuts (allergy).
NUT_FREE.note: No GS1 claim exists for this; AN = tree nuts, AP = peanuts.

FISH_FREE.label: fish-free
FISH_FREE.note: EU major allergen without a GS1 claim: evidence is the nonAllergen FREE_FROM AF entry; CONTAINS or MAY_CONTAIN AF contradicts. AF = fish in the GS1 AllergenTypeCode list (verify).

CRUSTACEAN_FREE.label: crustacean-free
CRUSTACEAN_FREE.description: free from crustaceans: shrimp, crab, lobster (allergy).
CRUSTACEAN_FREE.note: EU major allergen without a GS1 claim: evidence is the nonAllergen FREE_FROM AC entry; CONTAINS or MAY_CONTAIN AC contradicts. AC = crustaceans in the GS1 AllergenTypeCode list (verify).

MOLLUSC_FREE.note: EU major allergen without a GS1 claim: evidence is the nonAllergen FREE_FROM UM entry; CONTAINS or MAY_CONTAIN UM contradicts. UM = molluscs in the GS1 AllergenTypeCode list (verify).
